result.blocker: Text, detected language, segment range, lifecycle, cancellation, and artifact parity are proven, but the product timing includes one-shot context lifecycle and is not yet a like-for-like reusable-engine inference measurement; energy and statistical release-corpus gates also remain.
observations: The Rust product reproduces the legacy Whisper hypothesis exactly for explicit language and auto-detection.
The legacy constant confidence value is deliberately omitted because it is not measured confidence.
Three complete create/transcribe/dispose cycles produced identical results without material process-memory growth.
The packed ESM/CommonJS artifact exercised both local backends and active Whisper cancellation without invoking a compiler during installation.
The first process under a new executable identity spent about 124.82 seconds creating a Core ML execution plan; the warm one-shot process completed in about 1.65 seconds.
